a: staleReplay skips every per-node kit op on a removed node except `kit:setLod`, which throws instead
`changesSince` leaves out the dependents of a node that left the scene, though their derived pose changed with it
b: A redo or undo of `kit:move` after an untracked edit can create a cycle and drop a subtree from the document, because stale-replay does not check for a cycle or the layer floor
In `kit:add`'s revert, the touched-ids feed notes the parent from the payload, not the parent the node actually leaves
`loadState` trims an `EditingSession`'s selection without telling its subscribers
`sceneMutators.setChildOrder` reorders ids under a different parent when the list names a node that is not a child of `parentId`
